import copy
nested = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
shallow = copy.copy(nested) # inner lists are still shared
shallow[0].append(99)
print(nested) # [[1, 2, 99], [3, 4]]
deep = copy.deepcopy(nested) # fully independent
deep[0].append(100)
print(nested) # unchanged
Note: Shallow copy copies only the outer list. Deep copy copies every level. Asked very often.
